mapper.update: MERGE INTO T_MDM_MONTH_PROD_PLAN a USING (SELECT M.MATERIAL_CODE, M.MONTH_PLAN_APS_VERSION, NVL(F.FINISH_QTY, 0) - (NVL(M.ACTUAL_ARRANGEMENT, 0) + NVL(S.PLAN_MODIFY_QTY, 0) + NVL(S.SAP_BAD_QTY, 0) - NVL(S.LAST_MONTH_STOCK, 0)) ACTUAL_OVER_PRODUCTION FROM (SELECT P.MATERIAL_CODE, MAX(P.MONTH_PLAN_APS_VERSION) MONTH_PLAN_APS_VERSION, NVL(SUM(P.ACTUAL_ARRANGEMENT), 0) ACTUAL_ARRANGEMENT FROM T_MDM_MONTH_PROD_PLAN P INNER JOIN T_MDM_MONTH_PLAN_MAIN M ON P.MONTH_PLAN_APS_VERSION = M.MONTH_PLAN_APS_VERSION WHERE M.YEAR = #{year} AND M.MONTH = #{month} AND M.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND P.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND M.IS_FINALIZED = '0' /*只有定稿需要处理*/ GROUP BY P.MATERIAL_CODE) M LEFT JOIN T_CX_MONTH_PLAN_SURPLUS S ON S.MONTH_PLAN_APS_VERSION = M.MONTH_PLAN_APS_VERSION AND S.SAP_CODE = M.MATERIAL_CODE AND DEL_FLAG = '0' LEFT JOIN (SELECT SAP_CODE, SUM(NVL(DAY_FINISH_QTY, 0)) FINISH_QTY FROM T_LH_DAY_FINISH_QTY T WHERE FINISH_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND IS_DELETE = '0' GROUP BY SAP_CODE) F ON M.MATERIAL_CODE = F.SAP_CODE) B ON (A.MATERIAL_CODE = B.MATERIAL_CODE AND A.MONTH_PLAN_APS_VERSION = B.MONTH_PLAN_APS_VERSION) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ACTUAL_OVER_PRODUCTION = B.ACTUAL_OVER_PRODUCTION
